transferHint: Give this class's sets to another class and carry students' card records into it. This class's sets and reports stay as they are.
noOtherClass: You have no other class yet. Create one from the class dashboard first.
noSetsToMove: No sets have been given to this class.
copySettings: Also copy class defaults, lesson memos and order
copySettingsHint: The target's defaults are replaced; memos and order are added after its own rows.
keepDueHint: When off, sets are given without a due date.
carryHint: Pick each new student's record in the old class. Unique same names are matched for you.
carryMoves: Carried: card mastery and review dates, stars, misses of the last 4 weeks
carryStays: Stays in the old class: study counts, test scores and attempts, lateness, points, games, parent links
carryEmpty: The target class has no students yet. Add them, then move again to carry records.
cloneHint: Creates a class without students and gives the chosen sets to all its students. Add students on the class dashboard.
plannerHint: Give each set a study day to see it by date, next to its due date. Study days are guidance only.
agendaEmpty: Nothing is planned for the next two weeks.
sharedHint: When a colleague shares a folder with you, its sets marked shared appear here. The search box searches within them.
sharedEmpty: No folders shared with you yet
sharedEmptyHint: Ask a colleague to share a folder with your Google email.
sharedFolderEmpty: No shared sets in this folder.
copyNotAllowed: The owner has not allowed copies, so you can only view it.
folderShareHint: One colleague Google email per line (up to 30). Only sets marked shared in this folder are visible; no student data is shared. Removing an email takes effect at once.
folderSharedSets: Sets colleagues can see in this folder: {n}
visibilityShared: Visible to colleagues of a shared folder
shareNeedsFolder: Put the set in a folder and share the folder so colleagues can see it.
shareInFolder: Visible to colleagues of the '{name}' folder.
versusPick: Open as class vs class · classes
versusHint: Students of the chosen classes join with the same code. Each class is a team scored by its average, so class sizes may differ.
versusLobby: One team per class, scored by the class average.
versusNoReward: Class vs class rooms do not pay points. Give points per class instead.
huntHint: Students type the answer. Only the first right answer scores 1,000 and the answer is shown at once. Three tries a question; card alternatives count.
huntOut: No tries left. Wait for your friends.
huntNobody: Nobody got it. Here is the answer.
chunkEditHint: Tap the dot between two words to break there; tap again to join. Students read chunk by chunk, then rebuild the sentence.
chunkNeedWords: A sentence needs two words or more.
chunkIntro: Read each sentence in the chunks your teacher marked, then put shuffled chunks in order. Practice only; nothing is recorded.
chunkNone: Your teacher has not cut any sentence yet.
chunkTapHint: Tap the chunks below in order.
chunkWrong: Not in order. Tap a chunk to take it out and try again.
chunkScore: {right} of {total} sentences right on the first try.
chunkNoRecord: Practice only: not part of study records or scores.
chunkEntryHint: Read in the chunks your teacher marked and rebuild them.
drillChoiceBlankHint: Put each answer in brackets and list wrong options below, separated by commas. Students see ( 1 ).
drillShortBlankHint: Put each answer in brackets. Accept several answers like [have/own].
drillChoiceHint: Two to five options, shown shuffled.
drillIntro: Answer one question at a time and check right away. Practice only; the test gives the score.
drillNoRecord: Practice only: not part of study records or scores.
drillSetHint: Drill sets are studied with Practise questions and the test, not memorize, recall or spell. There is no required study.
drillPublishHint: Drill sets have no required study; the test asks each question in its own kind.
drillMissingKind: A question has no text yet.
